data.narrative:
Dhruva Space is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised ₹27 crore to date. Valuation analysis draws on two applicable methods against a comp universe of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, Skyryse) alongside 5 public Space & Aerospace comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier to the ₹27 crore raised proxy, implying a valuation of $51 crore. Peer-median anchoring across the 4 private comparables yields a median valuation of $1.6 billion, with a range spanning $1.1 billion (Skyryse, Series C) to $8.0 billion (Sierra Space, Series C). The wide dispersion reflects stage and business-model heterogeneity within the peer set. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue for the target.

The two applicable methods produce a triangulated range of $44 million (low) to $1.9 billion (high), with a median of $825 million. The 43x spread between methods reflects fundamental uncertainty: stage-progression relies on early-stage capital as a proxy absent operational metrics, while peer-median anchoring is anchored to later-stage, potentially more mature comparables. Key uncertainties include Dhruva Space's revenue run-rate, customer traction, and the precise business focus within space & aerospace, which would better calibrate peer selection and narrow the valuation band.
